title: PENDULUS
description: “Pendulus” is an attempt at merging the compartmentalization foundation of Dieter Rams with the visual form of a pendulum's swing.
study_intro: Dieter Rams' compartmentalization, given the motion of a pendulum's swing.

study.label: Form
study.text: A compact, ordered box that anchors a sweeping arm and a large translucent disc.

study.label: Gesture
study.text: The arm and disc freeze the arc of a swing in mid-motion, against the stillness of the box.

study.label: Material
study.text: A white, ordered body and a slim metal arm carrying a translucent disc, shown on black so the silhouette carries it.
